newsitem.title: USA: Seagull Energy Q4 net shr $0.10 vs $0.12.
newsitem.headline: Seagull Energy Q4 net shr $0.10 vs $0.12.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: A one-time 1996 charge resulted from $10.0 million in pre-tax costs related to the company's October merger with Global Natural Resources. Without the charge, net earnings for 1996 would have totaled $38.0 million, or $0.59 per share, and Q4 net earnings would have been $15.1 million or $0.24 per share.

Results for fiscal 1995 included a pre-tax gain of $82 million from the sale of certain gas gathering and gas procesing assets, $8 million in pre-tax charges for severence and relocation costs incurred in a restructuring program and a non-cash pre-tax charge of $48.8 million related to the company's adoption of a provision regarding accounting for the impairment of long-lived assets. Ignoring that gain and both charges, Seagull would have recorded a 1995 net loss of $18.4 million, or $0.29 per share.
